title: FNOL Image Upload Crash
text: Mobile app crashes with OutOfMemoryError during First Notice of Loss (FNOL) when uploading >10MB accident scene photos.

title: Reserve Calculation Underflow
text: Claim reserve automated adjustment logic causes integer underflow when partial payouts exceed initial estimated reserve, leading to negative reserves.

title: Duplicate Claim Generation
text: Double-clicking the 'Submit Claim' button on the web portal creates duplicate claim records in the core system due to missing idempotency keys.

title: Missing Police Report Validation
text: The rules engine fails to mandate a police report number for comprehensive auto claims exceeding $5,000 threshold.

title: Payout Rounding Discrepancy
text: ACH payout files round down to the nearest dollar instead of nearest cent, causing micro-reconciliation failures with the banking gateway.

title: Auto-Pay Double Charge
text: Customers on monthly EFT auto-pay are being billed twice if their billing cycle date falls on the 31st of a month.

title: Invoice PDF Generation Timeout
text: ERR-INV-504: Invoice PDF generation times out for commercial fleet policies with over 1,000 listed vehicles.

title: Stripe Webhook Ignored
text: Payment success webhooks from Stripe are randomly dropped, leaving policies in 'Pending Cancellation' state despite successful payment.

title: Pro-Rata Refund Calculation Bug
text: Mid-term cancellations are calculating flat-rate refunds instead of pro-rata refunds, violating state DOI regulations.

title: Currency Conversion Failure
text: International travel insurance module fails to convert GBP to USD at checkout, charging USD amounts identically to GBP amounts.

title: Underwriting Auto-Decline Bypass
text: Applicants with a DUI history within 3 years are bypassing the auto-decline rule if they select 'Other' for vehicle primary use.

title: MVR API Timeout
text: Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) third-party API integration times out after 10 seconds, causing silent fallbacks to 'Clean Record' tier.

title: Incorrect Premium Multiplier
text: Territory base rate multiplier for coastal zip codes is applying a 1.2x factor instead of the filed 1.8x factor for windstorm peril.

title: Health Questionnaire XSS
text: Stored XSS vulnerability in the medical history free-text field. Allows malicious script execution in the underwriter workbench view.

title: Missing Age Validation
text: Life insurance quoting engine accepts negative integer values for applicant age, resulting in NaN premium calculations.

title: Endorsement Effective Date Bug
text: Adding a new driver endorsement mid-term forces the endorsement effective date to the policy inception date instead of the current date.

title: Missing Declarations Page
text: Newly bound HO-3 policies are generating policy packets without the mandatory declarations page PDF attachment.

title: Beneficiary Update Sync Failure
text: Beneficiary changes made via the customer portal do not sync to the legacy mainframe system, resulting in orphaned records.

title: Renewal Notice Not Sent
text: Automated 30-day renewal notices are failing to trigger for policies with a premium increase of exactly 0.0%.

title: Agent Commission Mismatch
text: Broker portal shows 15% commission rate, but the backend ledger calculates at 10% for new business umbrella policies.

title: Guidewire Sync Timeout
text: Nightly batch synchronization with Guidewire PolicyCenter fails with a 504 Gateway Timeout due to unindexed SQL queries on the staging table.

title: LexisNexis API Auth Failure
text: ERR-AUTH-909: Scheduled token rotation for LexisNexis CLUE reports failed, causing all claims history pulls to return 401 Unauthorized.

title: DocuSign Callback 500
text: DocuSign envelope completion callbacks are returning 500 Internal Server Error because the webhook listener expects a legacy XML payload instead of JSON.

title: Salesforce Lead Status Mismatch
text: Quotes bound in the rating engine are not updating the corresponding Salesforce Lead status to 'Closed Won'.

title: Mainframe Batch Job Failure
text: Job ACCT_DAY_END ABENDs on the AS400 mainframe due to a character encoding mismatch in the daily lockbox feed.

title: Blurry ID Card Image
text: Digital proof of insurance (Auto ID card) renders at 72dpi on high-density displays, making the barcode unscannable by law enforcement.

title: Biometric Login Crash iOS
text: iOS app crashes immediately upon invoking FaceID if the user has revoked camera permissions in the system settings.

title: Offline Mode Sync Loop
text: Field adjuster iPad app gets stuck in an infinite sync loop when trying to upload claims data offline on a latent 3G connection.

title: Blank Screen on Quote Bind
text: React SPA displays a white screen of death after clicking 'Bind Policy' due to an unhandled exception in the confetti animation library.

title: Missing Back Button
text: Users get trapped on the 'Select Coverage' flow on mobile web because the back button is hidden behind the fixed header.

title: PII Exposed in URL Params
text: Applicant Social Security Numbers are passed in plaintext as query parameters (e.g., ?ssn=123) during the credit check redirect.

title: JWT Token Expiration Too Long
text: Session JWT tokens have an expiration time of 30 days without sliding window revocation, violating NIST identity guidelines.
